description: This source file defines the JmsConnectionFactory interface, responsible for creating JMS Connection instances within the messaging infrastructure of the Eclipse Ditto project. It specifies a method to create a JMS Connection with necessary parameters, including connection configuration, exception handling, and logging.

classes.name: JmsConnectionFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating JMS Connection objects configured with specific connection details, exception handling, and logging.

methods.name: createConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a JMS Connection using a provided Connection configuration, ExceptionListener for handling JMS exceptions, and a ConnectionLogger for logging purposes. May throw JMSException or NamingException if the creation fails.
